d:
Aaj jharkhand vidhanasbha ka 26van sthapna divas hai. vidhanasbha parisar men ise lekar karyakarm aayojit kiya gaya. is mauke par majhganv vidhanasbha sit se vidhayak niral purti ko sal 2026 ke bhagvan birsa munda utkrisht vidhayak samman se sammanit kiya gaya. rajyapal radha krishn kishor ne ye samman apne hathon se vidhayak ko diya. spikar ravindranath mahto ki adhyakshata men chayan samiti ne vidhayak ke nam par muhar lagaee thi. is chayan samiti ka hissa neta pratipaksh babulal marandi samet any sadasy bhi shamil the.
